U.note: Many controls and a live ink preview, but the canvas starts blank black and the small canvas sits beside a lot of empty space.

V.note: Elegant two-color ratio mixer with a glyph orb and hex validation, but it is a single static mix, a bit passive and cut off below the fold on desktop.

W.note: Rich three-source field with draggable sources, light/paint/naive models and a probe, immediately colorful and responsive on mobile.

X.note: Useful side-by-side comparison of sRGB vs linear light with keyboard shortcuts, but the ASCII output is a tiny static block and the design is plain.

Y.note: Paint-on-canvas mixer with picker, but it opens empty and black, and the canvas card has a dead white area below the canvas.

Z.note: Pre-seeded paintable field showing additive vs subtractive mixing with a theme flip, clear ink buttons and cell inspector; polished and works well on mobile.
